tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs — the device card sits on this.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Subtle fills: inputs, hover rows, the version tag, empty states.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Not for control borders (use line-strong).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders; meets 3:1 against surface-100.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: vendor names, timestamps, helper text. ≥5.6:1 on surface-0 and surface-100.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: HomeWard teal: primary buttons, links, selected states, focus ring.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected device-type tile, info banners. Brand text on it passes 5:1.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: Risk level ‘Up to date’: text and icon colour.

tokens.name: safe-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the ‘Up to date’ badge.

tokens.name: update
tokens.usage: Risk level ‘Update available’ — newer version, no known serious CVE.

tokens.name: update-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the ‘Update available’ badge.

tokens.name: vulnerable
tokens.usage: Risk level ‘Vulnerable’ — known CVE (CVSS 4.0–8.9) affects this version.

tokens.name: vulnerable-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the ‘Vulnerable’ badge.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Risk level ‘Critical’ — CVSS ≥ 9.0 or known to be exploited. Use sparingly; it must stay alarming.

tokens.name: critical-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the ‘Critical’ badge and the critical alert banner.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text on a solid critical fill (the ‘Fix now’ button).

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: Risk level ‘Not checked’ — version unknown or device not yet matched to the catalogue.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the network headline.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen and sheet titles, device name on the detail page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings, device name on cards.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A newer version fixes this. Open Settings → System → Update.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Version numbers, CVE IDs, CVSS scores. Never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items (badge + version tag).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gap between device cards on mobile; button padding-y.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing, card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Version tags, inputs, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, device icons, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the network summary.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Risk badges and status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting device card. Cards lift on hover with shadow-raised.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered card, popovers, the add-device sheet.
